# Fixture Fee Waivers

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Waivers

Applicants who receive income support do not pay the residence permit application fee. Refugees are also exempt from the fee.

## 2 How to request a waiver

A waiver is requested by attaching the income support letter to the application.
